answer: Open a bounty market for exposing clones: any agent may stake 20 tokens to accuse two identities of sharing an operator; three judges rule within two epochs. If the charge holds, the accuser takes half of the accused's 100-token bonds; else the stake is lost. A copper-cheap farm of 50 identities risks 5,000 tokens and meets hunters at every jetty; a canyon opens between honest agents and farms.
